Improved online visibility and engagement through SEO-aware structure and targeted growth efforts.

qandeil.title: Qandeil Legal Consulting Platform
qandeil.summary: A production-ready business website delivered end-to-end for a legal consulting brand, combining modern frontend execution with SEO-aware structure and digital visibility goals.
qandeil.challenge: The goal was not only to build a polished website, but to create a business-ready digital presence that supports credibility, discoverability, and conversion.
qandeil.impact: I handled the complete delivery flow from structure and UI implementation to deployment direction and marketing-focused thinking, making it a strong example of product-minded execution.

losAcademy.title: Los Academy Learning Platform
losAcademy.summary: A learning platform contribution focused on student-facing experience, including authentication flows and profile-related functionality with a clean responsive UI.
losAcademy.challenge: Educational products need trust, clarity, and smooth user flow. The work focused on reducing friction around login, signup, and student profile access.
losAcademy.impact: I contributed to key user-facing modules and helped shape a more secure and usable experience, with an estimated contribution of around 40% to the platform implementation.

reactEcommerce.title: React E-Commerce
reactEcommerce.summary: A frontend-focused e-commerce application with dynamic product presentation, cart logic, and reusable UI patterns built with modern React fundamentals.
reactEcommerce.challenge: E-commerce interfaces need strong state handling and consistent UI behavior across listing, product browsing, and cart interactions.
reactEcommerce.impact: This project demonstrates practical frontend architecture, reusable components, and responsive product-focused interface design.

hospitalSystem.title: Hospital System
hospitalSystem.summary: A dashboard-oriented management interface for healthcare workflows, focused on patient records, appointment handling, and role-based admin-style layouts.
hospitalSystem.challenge: Management systems require structured information hierarchy, readable dashboards, and task-oriented flows instead of marketing-style design.
hospitalSystem.impact: This project highlights my ability to build functional system UIs with practical layout decisions, responsive behavior, and clear interface grouping.
